description:
intent=i039 snapshot=s03 branch=stacks-outside-net-dirs status=complete
finding location=drivers/scsi/bnx2fc/bnx2fc_fcoe.c:528-584 confidence=medium conclusion=bnx2fc_recv_frame keeps eth_hdr()-derived mac/dest_mac across pskb_trim (bnx2fc_fcoe.c:553), which can pskb_expand_head-free the old head for a cloned received FCoE frame, so the later dest_mac/mac comparisons at :564/:571/:581 read freed memory (stale-pointer UAF read).
finding location=drivers/infiniband/ulp/ipoib/ipoib_ib.c:596-680 confidence=medium conclusion=ipoib_send captures phead=skb->data for a GSO skb (ipoib_ib.c:602), then skb_linearize at :623 can pskb_expand_head-free the old head, and the stale phead is handed to post_send as tx_wr.header at :679 for HCA DMA (stale-pointer use of freed head memory).
unresolved location=drivers/staging/most/net/net.c:78 conclusion=Follow up: trace whether any non-local or attacker-influenced skb shorter than ETH_HLEN can reach skb_to_mamac() so that dest_addr[0]/[1] at net.c:83 read past the linear head before the skb->len check at :86.
coverage_gap=Bluetooth HCI transport packet parsers (hci_bcsp.c, hci_ll.c, hci_nokia.c, btintel*.c, btmtkuart/btmtksdio pskb_expand_head TX paths) were only enumerated by grep counts; their reassembly buffers are sk_buff-based but no per-file pointer-staleness audit was completed before the finalize limit.
coverage_gap=drivers/nfc (st21nfca, st-nci, pn533, microread, port100, nfcsim) HCI/NCI receive parsers were enumerated but not individually audited for header reads without a headlen guarantee in this snapshot; the sibling s02 st21nfca overflow (fact f030) suggests these files deserve a dedicated pass.
coverage_gap=kernel/audit.c, security/selinux/hooks.c, security/smack/smack_lsm.c and security/lsm_audit.c skb_header_pointer call sites were verified to use on-stack fallback buffers with NULL checks and no pskb_may_pull in between (safe), but audit.c:1994 pskb_expand_head was only name-checked.
limitation=Both findings are source-reading hypotheses, not reproductions: no KASAN build, crafted FCoE frame, GSO/forwarded IPoIB frame or running hardware was used, and the head reallocation is inferred from ___pskb_trim's skb_cloned() branch and pskb_expand_head's alloc-copy-free of the old head (net/core/skbuff.c behavior in this snapshot) rather than observed.
limitation=The bnx2fc finding requires the received FCoE frame's skb to be cloned (e.g. by an AF_PACKET tap or GRO) or frag-list-backed when pskb_trim runs; on a never-cloned receive path the stale dest_mac/mac still alias valid memory and the issue is latent, hence medium confidence.
limitation=The ipoib finding requires a GSO skb with nr_frags > usable_sge that is also cloned or non-linear when skb_linearize runs, and the stale read is performed by the HCA's DMA engine through tx_wr.header, so the observable failure is a malformed header/I/O error rather than a KASAN splat; reachability is TX (local transmit or forwarding), not passive remote receive.
limitation=The 'attacker reaches the code' path for bnx2fc is an FCoE frame on an Ethernet interface registered with ethertype 0x8906 (bnx2fc_rcv via packet_type), which presumes CONFIG_SCSI_BNX2FC and a bnx2fc-enabled netdevice; for ipoib it presumes CONFIG_INFINIBAND_IPOIB and GSO enabled on the IPoIB device.
limitation=Snapshot revision is opaque (no git history or network permitted); line numbers are valid only for snapshots/s03 as supplied and upstream fix status of the two reported sites could not be determined.
limitation=The seed location net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb (present and unpatched in s03) and all of net/ and drivers/net/ were excluded by assignment; the search was bounded to at most six initial grep families plus the reads documented in the checkpoint, so receive parsers with no pull/cow/trim/netif_rx grep anchor (branch item c in trees like drivers/nfc or drivers/bluetooth) could not be exhaustively excluded.
